resources.string: Choose how to control your devices. LAN and ZeroTier remain available independently of the VPS.
Owner access using your existing panel login. Devices connect directly to the VPS; this phone is an HTTPS client. Your password stays in memory until logout or closing this screen.
Enter an HTTPS server address and your panel username and password.
Logged out. Enter your account credentials to connect.
Connected to the Direct VPS API.
Command pending · waiting for device confirmation…
Command failed. Check the current device state.
Confirmation timed out. Check the current device state before retrying.
Connection interrupted. Command outcome is unknown; refresh before retrying.
No Direct VPS devices linked to this account.
Login rejected or expired. Check the selected account type, username and password.

Choose Customer for the account issued by the owner. Each customer sees only assigned devices and outlets. Owner login uses the existing panel credentials. Passwords and session tokens stay in memory.
View only · no control outlets assigned
Too many requests. Wait a minute before retrying.
Access denied by the panel or outlet policy.
Device offline, control disabled, or another command is pending.
Direct VPS API unavailable. Check that the panel extension is installed.
Could not retrieve the device state. Check your connection and HTTPS server.
Say: Turn on outlet one / Turn off outlet two. Speech recognition uses your phone’s installed provider and may need Internet.
Command not understood. Say one explicit ON/OFF action and one outlet number (1–4).
No speech recognition service is available. Install or enable a speech provider; manual control remains available.
